fields.summary_ko.0: AMAT fell 29% over one month and currently trades at $381.01, up 49% since the start of the year, with earnings report scheduled for November 12.
fields.summary_ko.1: INTC's weak earnings outlook transmitted weakness across the semiconductor equipment industry, with LRCX down 34% and KLAC down 25%.
fields.summary_ko.2: China represents 28% of AMAT's record quarterly revenue of $9.12B, making strengthened export restrictions a key variable for earnings.
